name: bonança (Free Concert)
description: Kick off the weekend early with a free show from bonança, blending post-rock and bedroom pop in the relaxed atmosphere of the Casa da Música Café.
longDescription:
On Thursday, October 22, 2026, bonança will perform a free concert at the Casa da Música Café. The musical project, known for its blend of post-rock and bedroom pop, will present their original compositions. This event offers an opportunity to hear new music in a casual setting.

Attendees can expect a relaxed atmosphere suitable for an evening concert. The performance is scheduled to begin at 21:30, providing an early start to the weekend's cultural offerings. The Casa da Música Café offers an intimate setting within the larger architectural context of the Casa da Música.

Admission to the concert is free, and no tickets are required. Guests are welcome to arrive and find a spot. The Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station, a short walk from the venue.
